verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a dedicated multi-user permissions system with dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage explicitly designed to keep multiple users' or organizations' data 'completely separate,' plus session memory keyed by (user_id, session_id) for per-user isolation. The founder's HN comment corroborates 'graphs per user' with 'user permissions + graph filtering' as an available mechanism, aligning with the documented feature. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that cross-tenant leakage is actually prevented in practice, and more detail on agent/application-level (vs just user-level) scoping.
